name: Tansuo D1
summary:
Tansuo D1 (探索D1) is a full-size electrically actuated humanoid developed by CETC’s 21st Research Institute and CETC Robotics. CETC announced it at the November 2025 small-motor exhibition in Shanghai. Its developers use physical-model-based perception and motion control.

CETC describes protected joints and wiring, pressure-sensitive fingers, autonomous charging, obstacle avoidance and recovery after falling. The robot targets logistics, manufacturing and specialized operations. Published dimensions and mobility limits are manufacturer-reported specifications rather than independently verified
